title: ECG-Expert-QA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Medical Large Language Models in Heart Disease Diagnosis
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, ECG-Expert-QA, is designed to evaluate the diagnostic capabilities, clinical reasoning, diagnostic accuracy, and knowledge integration of medical large language models in the context of electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation for heart disease.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
